meta.title: Service requests | Invessiv
meta.description: Manage service requests from the customer portal.

title: Service requests
description: Clarify additional services and assign them to the right project.

empty.title: No service requests yet
empty.description: Additional services customers request in the portal appear here. Send an offer and accept the request once the customer has agreed.

noOpen.title: No open service requests
noOpen.description: Previous requests have been resolved. You can still view them.

form.offeredNotice: Accept the request only after the customer has agreed to the offer. They will then see it as confirmed in the portal.
form.withoutOfferNotice: No offer has been sent for this request. The customer does not know the price and will still see the service as confirmed once you accept.
form.withoutOfferConfirm: I am deliberately accepting without an offer, for example as a goodwill gesture.
form.projectHint: Standard process with two feedback rounds. You can change it later in the project editor.
form.templateUnavailable: The original template is no longer available. Choose an active template of the same kind.
form.reasonHint: The customer will see this text.
form.validation: Check the required fields and price.
form.conflict: The request has changed. Your input is preserved. Check the current status before saving again.
form.noProject: You cannot currently assign a service to a project.
form.noTemplate: No matching active template is available.

errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: The request has already been processed. Reload the current status.
errors.OFFER_REQUIRED: No offer has been sent for this request. Confirm that you want to accept without an offer.
errors.KIND_MISMATCH: The template must match the requested kind.
errors.TEMPLATE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: The template is no longer active. Choose another.
errors.EFFECT_NOT_PERMITTED: You lack permission for this assignment.
errors.PROJECT_CLOSED: Closed projects cannot receive hours. You can credit the hours to free stock instead.
errors.FEEDBACK_ROUND_NOT_AVAILABLE: This project cannot receive another feedback round.
errors.INTERNAL: The request could not be saved. Try again.
